ruling: Use the target speaker’s voiced seconds divided by the sum of all speakers’ voiced seconds in the next 60 seconds. Exclude silence.
baseline: Use the same definition in the preceding 60 seconds. Overlapping speech from different speakers contributes each speaker’s voiced time; overlapping annotations of the same speaker count once.
undefined: Exclude a pair of windows if either total is zero. Report undefined shares and truncated windows separately.
attribution: Retain the frozen single-candidate laughter target and whole-meeting resampling.
